title: Stalwart Protector
description: Once per session, when you **suffer dmg that isn't** **piercing**, you may ignore it entirely. If the dmg came from an enemy, also choose one:

bullets: They leave themselves open and exposed
You learn a weakness or limitation of theirs
You infuriate or terrify them (GM's call)—and they act accordingly

submoves.title: I Am Your Shield
submoves.description: When you interpose yourself between a **near** ally and an attack or source of dmg, you suffer its effects instead of them.

title: Armiger
description: You know how to customize your armor and bring the best out of it. Choose one enhancement now:
pickOne: **concealed** (it looks and sounds like mundane clothing)
spiked (when a foe deals dmg to you, they take 1 dmg **piercing** in return)
warded (choose a non-physical dmg type such as acid or fire; it's never **piercing** for you)

outcomes.text: When you successfully **Make Camp**, you may clear a use of a shield or change which enhancement your armor has.
When you **Face Death**, you also have access to the following option:
bullets: *Not as Bad As It Looks*. Grit your teeth, force yourself through the pain, and get back up with 1 HP. You're no longer Helpless and you don't lock a Condition, but you can't choose this option again until after you successfully **Make Camp**.

title: Silent Protector
description: When **a combat situation begins**, choose an ally (PC or NPC) **near** you and gain the following benefits until the battle ends:

bullets: *Retaliate*. When they get hurt for 2 or more dmg, gain **adv** on your next roll against the dmg source
*Watchful Eye*. You can always appear **near** them in a pinch, no matter where you were before. If you were in a tough spot, the GM will say how it's developed since you left

title: Taunting Shout
description: When you cry out a challenge to your enemies, name one among them. For now, they will ignore your allies and treat you as the most obvious threat.
